items.title: Aldar details 388-apartment Canopies Sanctuary at Yas Point
items.summary: Second Yas Point release: 388 studios to three-bedroom apartments in three buildings around an 11,000 sqm park. Sales open 25 November 2026; completion expected Q1 2031.

items.project: Palm Central Private Residences – Frond D
items.title: Nakheel adds 216 waterfront homes at Palm Central
items.summary: Three stepped buildings overlooking the Cove between Fronds C and D, with one- to five-bedroom apartments, duplex townhouses and penthouses. Takes Palm Central to 650 homes across three releases.

items.title: Sobha City Abu Dhabi first phase sold out
items.summary: Sobha says River Cove Residences, The Terraces and The Orchard, the first phase of Sobha City, have sold out. The next release is coming soon, with prices on request.

items.title: Binghatti opens early booking for The Arts District
items.summary: Binghatti apartments in Al Rowaiyah First, with early booking (EOI) from AED 525,000. Handover not yet announced; some listings show it as Tilal Towers Phase 2.
